purpose: exact accounting for run-1: what was executed, under which subject and turn, in which call family, and why the turn count and the call count are different numbers

questions_this_ledger_answers.why_scientific_turn_count_is_11: the frozen schedule is 1 qualification turn + 5 turns for arm A + 5 turns for arm B. Turn 0 of each arm is a byte-identical shared opening; the schedule is counted in TURNS, and 11 is exactly the frozen number.
questions_this_ledger_answers.why_runtime_turn_count_is_not_11_for_eve: each subject runs its own session. The qualification subject ran 1 turn, arm A ran turns 0..4, arm B ran turns 0..4. Arm B's turn index did NOT advance on its failed turn (documented fail-closed behaviour), so its later turns were refused at ingress rather than executed.
questions_this_ledger_answers.why_provider_call_count_is_39: 39 = cognition 9 + language 8 + appraisal 14 + belief-semantic 8. Only the belief-semantic family can move the endpoint. Three of the 11 turns never reached the belief-semantic step because they failed earlier in the turn lifecycle.
questions_this_ledger_answers.why_belief_semantic_count_is_8: 1 belief-semantic attempt per turn that reached the adaptation step. 11 turns − 3 failed turns = 8. The shortfall is a CONSEQUENCE of the failures, not a deviation from the frozen schedule.

instrumentation_gap_found_and_fixed.fix: the harness records every attempt of every family with its turn label, family, request hash and result status; verified in the 0-call smoke run
